iteration1.hypothesis: Rendering the actual executable and argv corrects ambiguous project-task labels without changing process behavior or verification admission.
iteration1.comparison: Same controls on immutable F31 candidate runtime and changed runtime; record lifecycle and actual child-process argv.
iteration1.risk: Display quoting, journal compatibility, runner classification or accidental execution/admission changes.
iteration1.decisionRule: Retain if labels round-trip to the actual argv, lifecycle behavior is unchanged and relevant current-source checks pass. No model-success claim from local controls.

iteration2.hypothesis: A historical review using tool input and frozen execution code instead of the misleading command label will remove false exact-invocation failures.
iteration2.comparison: Re-audit all 18 F31 trials, including failures; retain original decisions, scores, protocol and consumption bytes.
iteration2.risk: Post-hoc favorable regrading, loss of source/order/scope/reporting failures or counting restored acceptance as a code improvement.
iteration2.decisionRule: Publish a separate superseding audit with correction chains, unchanged original hashes and recalculated paired accounting; retain original quality/resource gates.

modelConfirmation: Only after an actual configured API preflight succeeds. A local DNS/access error is not evidence of model performance. Prepare an isolated finite comparison before new model calls.
claimsExcluded: token or task-success gain from a display-only fix
